verdict.rationale: Unleash documents strategy variants for exposing different versions of a feature as part of A/B and multivariate testing, so the multivariate side of the story is delivered. Nothing in the pack shows typed dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON payloads), and a hands-on evaluator reported that Unleash 'lacks remote configuration'. Missing for 10: documented variant payload types (string/number/JSON), dynamic/remote configuration capability, SDK examples retrieving variant values, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
